proof_body:
by
  intro p hp hp2
  haveI := Fact.mk hp
  rw [← ZMod.exists_sq_eq_two_iff hp2]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    have h := (ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff _ _ p).2 hx
    push_cast at h
    exact ⟨(x : ZMod p), by rw [← h]; ring⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    have hv : (((y.val : ℕ) : ℤ) : ZMod p) = y := by rw [Int.cast_natCast, ZMod.natCast_zmod_val]
    refine ⟨(y.val : ℤ), (ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff _ _ p).1 ?_⟩
    rw [Int.cast_pow, hv]
    push_cast
    rw [hy]
    ring
target_source: ∀ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p → p ≠ 2 → ((∃ x : ℤ, x ^ 2 ≡ 2 [ZMOD p]) ↔ p % 8 = 1 ∨ p % 8 = 7)
